messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — starting staged rollout for model_v9 today. Plan is: 1) 1% global for 30m, 2) widen to region slices (NA/EU/APAC) with different percents, 3) 10% global if signals look good. Will flip the feature flag `ff:model_v9_rollout` via ops-api.
jon: copied. what's the initial region split? do we start with NA-only or all regions at 1%?
sree: prefer NA 1% then EU 0.5% and APAC 0.2% next step. keeps risk low while we watch latency tails.
alyssa: +1 to regional ramp. can we put automatic fallback so traffic drops to v8 if error rate > 2% for 5m?
maria: yes — adding rollback rule. will wire these tiggers into the rollout config. thresholds: error_rate >= 2% (5m), p99 latency +1200ms vs baseline (5m), and elevated prompt-clipping / truncation alerts.
deploy-bot: NOTE: scheduled rollout job created: job_id=job_20260317_01, target_flag=ff:model_v9_rollout, start=2026-03-17T15:00:00Z
jon: pinging infra for preflight: canary infra reserved? need non-shared pool for NA 1% to avoid noisy neighbors.
sree: infra confirmed — reserved slice id=rs-34. autoscale policy attached.
alyssa: quick config snippet for ops-api (will push to PR):
```
{
  "flag": "ff:model_v9_rollout",
  "phases": [
    {"duration_mins": 30, "regions": {"NA": 1}},
    {"duration_mins": 60, "regions": {"NA": 5, "EU": 1, "APAC": 0.5}},
    {"duration_mins": 120, "global": 10}
  ],
  "rollback_rules": [
    {"metric": "error_rate", "op": ">=", "value": 2.0, "window_mins": 5},
    {"metric": "p99_latency_ms", "op": ">=", "value": "baseline+1200", "window_mins": 5}
  ]
}
```
maria: looks good. can we also add a KL divergence check on embeddings for semantic drift (daily)? not blocking for first hour but needed before 10%.
alyssa: sure — add eval hook: embedding_kl_daily < 0.02 required to progress beyond 10%.
oncall: adding plan for alerting and escalation: if rollback fires, notify #eng-oncall + paging policy. manual rollback allowed via `ops-cli rollback job_20260317_01`.
jon: FYI I'll open a tiny PR to add a readme for the flag and a playbook snippet for oncall.
sree: code review ping @alyssa for the ops-api patch (small validation + unit tests).
alyssa: looking now — should be quick.
maria: final ask: whoever approves, please also run the canary smoke script: `scripts/canary_smoke.sh rs-34 model_v9` and paste results here.
jon: running now, will post results in 10m.
maria: thanks all — we'll meet async unless something trips. :rocket:
deploy-bot: job job_20260317_01 moved to phase 1 at 2026-03-17T15:00:00Z
jon: smoke results: 200 reqs, 0.5% errors, p99 latency +300ms, no abnormal truncation logs. posting gist: https://gist.github.com/jon/canary-smoke-modelv9
maria: perfect. proceeding to phase 2 tomorrow at 15:00Z unless anyone objects.
alyssa: no objections from me. I'll merge infra PR after tests pass.
oncall: noted. escalation path documented. :white_check_mark:
